lines.text: This is not the main gate.
When I was your age I trekked to school.
Manage it.
I am not angry.
I am only calculating.
We are managing. You manage too.
Greet your roommate. Your mother is fine.
…From your work?
I will tell your mother it came from you.
We managed. You have also managed.
Have you eaten? Don't spend the rest on shoes.
When I was your age…
…Well done. Take your mother.
Five years ago I parked here! Ask him! Ask him!
Chin up! Smile for your fa— they all look the same!
Hello. It's your father. Your mother is next to me. She says eat.
{{PLAYER_NAME}}. Good evening. I have three questions.
Ah. You picked up. On the first ring. What do you need?
Hello. I'm calling for no reason. Your mother made me.
Greet your roommate. Your mother is fine.
Read your books. Balance your books. Both kinds.
Okay. This call is costing money. Goodnight.
…Hm. Thank you. I'll tell your mother you said it first.
Sorry is good. A plan is better. What is the plan?
When I was your age I trekked to school. Both ways. Uphill.
Shoes again? How many feet do you have now?
Hello? Hello? Are you there? I'm paying for this silence.
Yes. Manage it.
No. A want is not a need. Write that on your wall.
Let me think about it. That means no, but politely.
What is 'sapa'? …Ah. I see. We called it 'month end'.
Correct. Finally, a sensible sentence. I'll write it down.
How much is left? Don't round. Give me the naira and the kobo.
Have you eaten? Your mother asked me to ask. I'm asking.
What did you buy? Itemise it. I'm holding a pen.
Your mother says I'm too strict. I've calculated. I'm exactly strict.
No light? When I was your age, light was a rumour. Read by day.
Raining? Don't stand under a tree. Or a transformer. Read inside.
Hot there? Then read early, before the sun gets ideas.
I am not angry. I am only calculating.
Money is a guest. If you don't respect it, it leaves early.
Manage it.
Cook. Don't buy every meal. A pot of rice is a week of peace.
A tie. …It's a good tie. I'll wear it on Monday. Or not. Yes. Monday.
From your own work? …I will tell your mother it came from you.
When I was your age… I'm starting again. When I was your age…
Your little one wants your old bicycle. I said ask you. Ask you.
That was not the main gate. I know it was the only gate. Still.
Did you register your courses? All of them? Show me the slip.
Your adviser. What's the name? I want to know who is watching you.
I am not angry. I am only calculating. …Good result. Hm. Good.
One carry-over. When I was your age, we called it a warning.
…Well done. Don't tell your mother I said it first.
Allowance sent. Food first, books second, nonsense never.
That is for the whole month. Not for the first weekend.
Your friend has a shop. Does he keep a ledger? Ask him. Ask him.
A mall with its own power. Who is paying for that power? Think.
Up from last year. I've plotted it. The line is going up.
Down. I've plotted it. I don't like this line.
Allowance sent. Last month you spent it in nine days. Make it ten.
You asked for 'small extra'. Define small. Define extra.
We are managing. You manage too.
Strike or no strike, read. The exam will come back. Exams always do.
I'm reading your textbook. Chapter one. Your field is… brave.
You're doing small jobs? Good. Work is not shame. Idleness is.
It's less this month. Things are tight. I'm sorry. Manage it.
You're on the internet. Is the internet paying your fees?
Reputation is like a ledger. Every entry stays.
Good. I told my colleagues. Twice. They've asked me to stop.
One more year to fix it. That's enough time. I've calculated.
You sent money home? …I'm returning it. With a lecture attached.
Final year. Your project. Is it finished? Is it on time? Is it safe?
We managed. You have also managed.
…Well done. Take your mother. She's crying. I'm not. Network.
Five years ago I parked here! Ask him! Ask him!
Chin up! Smile! Wait, which one is you? You all look the same!
Last one. After this, the allowance is you. …Manage it.
New freshers? Show them the way. Show them the bank queue too.
Exams. Switch off that phone. After this call. Not during.
Read the question twice. I always told you. You never listened.
When I was your age, results were pinned with a nail.
Check your account. Then check your spending. In that order.
Your faculty won? When I was your age I scored once. Just once.
Christmas break. The bus fare is sent. The bus fare only.
Harmattan. Close your window. Dust is not free cleaning.
